candidates.change_summary: Change the condition so winner branch triggers on random == 1 instead of random == 0, altering when pot is reset.
Change fee transfer to occur only (and pot reset) when random != 0, i.e., invert condition using !=, affecting when pot becomes 0.
Remove the pot reset so pot is never set to 0 after a win, leaving pot unchanged after payouts.
Set pot to 0 unconditionally at end of play, causing pot to always be zero after any call.
Move pot increment to after the random check so pot only increases when not winning, changing resulting pot values.
Change the required msg.value so play accepts 0 or 10 by using >= instead of ==, which allows calls that don't increase pot and thus can change resulting pot observed after play.
Change the randomness modulus from 2 to 3 so the probability of winning differs and thus pot after play can differ.
Change fee transfer target from bank to msg.sender so the winner receives different amounts and pot behaviour differs.
Move pot reset before transfers so pot is set to 0 prior to sending funds, changing sequence and observable pot after play.
Remove the fee transfer so only the winner is paid the full pot, changing the final pot value after play.
